description: The Asa Wright Nature Centre and Lodge is a nature resort and scientific research station in the Arima Valley of the Northern Range in Trinidad and Tobago. The centre is one of the top birdwatching spots in the Caribbean; a total of 256 species of birds have been recoded there. The centre is owned by a non-profit trust. Nestled in the Northern Mountain Range, the Asa Wright Nature Centre is one of the Caribbean's premier bird-watching spots. Visitors can explore guided birding tours, nature trails, pools, rivers and tasty Creole-style cooking or stay on the lodge's veranda and observe a myriad of birds. Listed opening hours: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
